sources.title: Configuring Lustre file striping
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: BeeGFS Buddy Mirroring：復原窗口與副本失效域
related.titleEn: BeeGFS buddy mirroring: rebuild windows and replica failure domains
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：估計可重算，真實部署仍需檔案系統版本與量測。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Estimates are reproducible; deployment needs filesystem-version and measurement evidence.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「BeeGFS Buddy Mirroring：復原窗口與副本失效域」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付 buddy 故障域圖、重建進度和一致性驗收記錄。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct BeeGFS buddy mirroring: rebuild windows and replica failure domains with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver buddy failure-domain maps, rebuild progress and consistency evidence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將 900 張小檔卡與 100 張成長檔卡換算物件需求。
由 6000 GB 建立每分鐘同步帳本，保留前景 I/O 預算。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Convert 900 small-file cards and 100 grown-file cards into object demand.
Build a per-minute ledger for 6000 GB while reserving foreground I/O capacity.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Slurm Job Array：併發上限與長尾批次
related.titleEn: Slurm job arrays: concurrency caps and tail batches
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：估計可重算，真實部署仍需檔案系統版本與量測。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Estimates are reproducible; deployment needs filesystem-version and measurement evidence.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Slurm Job Array：併發上限與長尾批次」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付 task ID 對照、批次甘特圖、獨立輸出與聚合依賴。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Slurm job arrays: concurrency caps and tail batches with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver task-ID mapping, batch Gantt charts, isolated outputs and aggregation dependencies.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將 900 張小檔卡與 100 張成長檔卡換算物件需求。
以八欄填滿一百二十張任務卡，每批標 30 min。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Convert 900 small-file cards and 100 grown-file cards into object demand.
Place 120 task cards in eight columns with 30 min per batch.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
